decisions.reason: The handle family leverages the firm’s existing door-hardware knowledge, enabling it to interpret early performance and refine the line rather than drop it.
As a mitred variant of core handle families, it is closely related to proven expertise, so the firm can assimilate results and likely retain it.
The multifunctional handle builds on known mechanical and electronic access capabilities, giving the firm the absorptive capacity to learn from initial market response and keep improving it.
This handle line is within the firm’s established product domain, allowing it to recognize and act on early signals without discarding the product.
The collection has already received a German Design Award and has dedicated website presence, indicating strong early results that the firm can absorb and build on.
The new finish applies to existing handle families and can be evaluated with the firm’s finishing know-how, though it is more easily replaceable if demand is weak.
